summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing its condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with certifications and a press release dated August 12, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer; it contains no merger, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction announcements. The registrant's role is that of issuer filing routine financial disclosures. No deal terms or special-situation events are present.
